function: Excluded (above_phy): MADRL outputs UAV acceleration commands that fly a core UAV to the optical light-spot centre (UAV trajectory control); no beam, precoder or power is learned (p. 6).
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 6: "The control of the UAV is mainly achieved by adjusting the velocities in three directions", with the action a = (ax, ay, az); p. 5: "The UAV flight is controlled by the neural network output". The core UAV flies to the predicted light-spot centre while two assistant UAVs keep a Koch-snowflake formation. The optical link is a point-to-point LOS IM/DD OOK link (p. 3), with no learned beam, precoder, power or detector. If the alignment were read as a physical-layer decision, it would still fit none of areas 1 to 7 (function).
